title: Earlier Share from the Preceding Block in Medicare Part A Rate-Year Corrections
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — the earlier share.** The block before the corrected block is the coverage's booked-days entry in the band of benefit days 21 through 100 whose last benefit day is the day before the corrected block's first benefit day; its resident charge is the resident coinsurance charge posted for it that is not a rebill of a denied secondary share. The earlier share the rate-year correction applies is read from the block before: 50 percent when its resident charge bills half of that charge's own days times its own daily rate, to within half a percentage point; 25 percent when it bills a quarter, to within half a percentage point; 0 percent when the block before carries a secondary charge and no resident charge; and 100 percent otherwise.

| What the block before shows | Earlier share for the rate-year correction |
|---|---|
| Its resident charge bills half of that charge's own days times its own daily rate (to within half a percentage point) | 50 percent |
| Its resident charge bills a quarter of that charge's own days times its own daily rate (to within half a percentage point) | 25 percent |
| It carries a secondary charge (Medigap carrier or Medicaid crossover) and no resident charge | 0 percent |
| Anything else | 100 percent |

The earlier share is the share taken by the days the rate-year correction counts before the supplemental effective date.

*Hypothetical cases:*
- The block before carries a resident charge of 1519.00 for 14 days at a recorded 217.00 a day; 14 times 217.00 is 3038.00, and 1519.00 is half of it, so the earlier share is 50 percent.
- The block before carries only a Medigap carrier charge; the earlier share is 0 percent.
